page.layout: One column of running text, with a small mark in the right margin beside the fifth line. Running head at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: futura, de alea, de spe, disputa-ri licebit. quartò precium ex quiritur, quod in pecunia nu-merata & definita, certaque summa consistat. quintò, vo-luntas utriusque contrahen-tis certa & præsens, de domi-nio tam rei quàm precij, tũ tradendo, tum accipiendo. postremò, bona fides, in præ-stationibus ultro citroque ex æquo & bono faciendis. Qui-bus omnibus suo loco dispo-sitis, ordineq; collocatis, em-ptionis & venditionis defini-tio, quasi fastigium præclaro operi imponetur, si dicatur esse cõtractus bonæ fidei, in-ter quos iure ciuili licet, fa-ctus

page.notes: Right margin beside the fifth line ("quintò, vo-"): a faint printed mark, roughly three letters, too light to read, transcribed as an illegible note. Catchword "ctus" uses the ct ligature in print. Several words are set with a tilde (cõtractus, tũ), kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s, and u/v and i/j are corrected as instructed. "dispo sitis" has no printed hyphen across the line break, so it is written whole.
